title: ר' שמעון בן הלל הזקן

paragraphs: R' Shimon son of Hillel the Elder, a nasi like his father: Shabbat, first chapter; see Hillel the Elder. He is not mentioned in the Mishnah. He received, together with Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai, from Hillel and Shammai. His son was Rabban Gamliel the Elder.
